profile.name: Ishita Gautam
profile.tagline: builds systems that hold up under load.
profile.summary: Full-stack engineer with hands-on work across real-time systems, on-chain applications, and AI/ML — from a traffic-intelligence platform to a published health-AI app. Graduating May 2027 with a 9.26 CGPA.
about: I'm a final-year B.Tech CSE student at VIT Bhopal University, currently navigating campus placements while wrapping up a dual-track internship spanning software engineering and applied AI/ML.

My strongest ground is full-stack development — building backends, mobile apps, and the data layers underneath them. Alongside that, I've picked up practical experience in AI/ML (CNNs, NLP, recommendation logic) and blockchain (DAO architecture on ICP), which show up as secondary threads across my projects.
I care about systems that are honest about what they do — I'd rather ship something smaller that actually works than oversell a feature that isn't there yet.

bullets: Completed a dual-track internship spanning advanced software engineering and applied AI/ML, delivering two capstone projects.

Built a 5-service FastAPI AI platform integrating a Keras/TensorFlow CNN (trained on 60,000+ images) for product classification, OpenCV-based facial recognition, and an NLP sentiment/intent chatbot for retail intelligence.
Developed a full-stack ASP.NET Core MVC library management system (EF Core 8, Dockerized MySQL) with an automated borrowing/due-date engine and a glassmorphism analytics dashboard.
Built a full-stack CRUD application on the Internet Computer Protocol (ICP), enabling efficient on-chain data management.
Designed a DAO-based course management system with role-based access, applying dApp architecture patterns end to end.

projects.title: UDIE — Real-Time Traffic Intelligence
bullets: Architected a real-time traffic analysis platform using event-driven architecture and H3 hexagonal spatial indexing.
Integrated Redis caching to cut query response time by ~40% under peak load.
Built a cross-platform Flutter app and web dashboard on a NestJS backend, with hand-rolled Dijkstra/A* routing over an adjacency-list road graph.

projects.title: LifeTrack — AI Health Management
bullets: Designed and built an AI-powered mobile health app delivering personalised fitness and nutrition plans.
Used OOP/MVC in Android Studio with a MySQL-backed REST API for data sync.
Research on the recommendation model and app architecture accepted and published at IDBA 2025.
